newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Port conditions update - Sri Lanka - Lloyds Shipping.
newsitem.headline: Port conditions update - Sri Lanka - Lloyds Shipping.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

COLOMBO, Dec 16 - Eight container discharger/loaders, two food dischargers, one cement discharger, two general cargo dischargers two fertiliser dischargers, three food loaders and one general cargo loader presently working in port. Three breakbulk dischargers awaiting berths.
